summary: Early-game burst bully with point-and-click stun and long-range spear poke. He's strongest at levels 1–5 and falls off later. Survive his early pressure with armor and sustain, and he has little left to offer in lane.
threats: Q (Comet Spear) is long-range poke; empowered at 5 Mortal Will stacks, it deals bonus damage and slows.
W (Shield Vault) is a point-and-click dash and stun. It's how he starts every all-in.
E (Aegis Assault) blocks damage from the front, including tower shots.
R (Grand Starfall) at 5 lets him roam across the map. Ping when he disappears from lane.

matchups.why: Pantheon's burst is physical, which Malphite's armor and passive shield absorb. He can't kill Malphite early, and Malphite's targeted Q pokes him every time he walks up.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm.
Keep Granite Shield up before he W's in; it soaks his first burst.
E (Ground Slam) when he's in melee range to slow his autos.
Stand behind minions so his spear hits them instead.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Build armor early; he can't kill you through it.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R lets him roam. Ping when he disappears and push his tower.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; he can't dive you through armor.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when his W is down.
matchups.build: Grasp. Plated Steelcaps and early armor.

matchups.why: Garen's passive regen undoes Pantheon's poke, and W (Courage) tenacity shortens his stun. Garen's Q silence stops Pantheon casting during a trade, and he out-scales Pantheon in side lane.
trading: Q silence him when he W's in, so he can't follow up with spear.
Use W (Courage) as his stun lands to cut its duration.
Back off after trades to let Perseverance regen.
Stand behind minions to block his spear poke.
matchups.early: Farm and regen through his poke; trade with Q when he walks up.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R lets him roam. Ping when he disappears and push his tower.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when his W is on cooldown.
matchups.jungle: Gank when his W is down; he has no escape without it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his burst.
matchups.remember: Regen the poke, silence the dive.

matchups.why: Pantheon's early burst and poke out-trade Darius at range, but Darius wins any extended fight once he pulls Pantheon in. The lane comes down to whether Darius lands E before Pantheon's stun.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up to farm.
Stack Hemorrhage quickly before his E blocks your damage.
Walk around his E shield; it only blocks damage from the front.
Stand behind minions to block his spear poke.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when his W is on cooldown so he can't stun you out of your combo.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R lets him roam; your R resets on kill. Push his tower if he roams.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on his cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape without W. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his burst.

matchups.why: Pantheon's damage is mostly spells, so Teemo's blind barely helps. His W is a point-and-click dash and stun that reaches Teemo from range, and his spear out-pokes Teemo's autos.
trading: Stand behind minions to block his spear poke.
Blind him as soon as he W's in to cut his auto damage.
Move Quick away after the stun ends.
Shroom his approach paths at 5 to slow his dive.
matchups.early: Farm safely and accept some poke; don't trade while his W is available.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R lets him roam. Ping when he disappears and push his tower.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; don't walk into his spear range.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; he has no escape once W is down.
matchups.remember: Hide behind minions, shroom the dive.

matchups.why: Pantheon's level 1–5 burst out-damages Fiora, and his spear pokes her off farm. She can only win by parrying his W stun, and he can bait her Riposte with spear poke first.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his W stun and stun him back.
Don't Riposte his spear poke; save it for the stun.
Stand behind minions to block his spear.
Lunge onto vitals only when his W is on cooldown.
matchups.early: Farm safely and accept some poke; trade only after parrying his W.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R lets him roam. Ping when he disappears and push his tower.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; you outscale him later.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks once his W is down; he has no other escape.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his burst.
matchups.remember: Parry the stun, not the spear.
